result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.select_nodes_by_id()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Select nodes by their IDs. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L5504-L5552){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.select_nodes_by_id(node_ids) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Marks specified nodes as selected for subsequent operations like building subgraphs or filtering. Selection is cumulative unless cleared first. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [node_ids]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of node IDs (integers) to select. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [KeyError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If any node ID doesn't exist in the graph. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Selecting nodes by ID marks them for follow-up operations like building a subgraph. `get_selected_node_ids()` reports back the same IDs that were selected: ::: {#350a5f42 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") ) id_a = graph.get_id_from_label("A") id_b = graph.get_id_from_label("B") graph.select_nodes_by_id([id_a, id_b]) graph.get_selected_node_ids() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` [2, 1] ``` ::: :::
